payload.title: Rate-limit incoming webhooks per tenant
payload.goal: POST /webhooks answers 429 with a Retry-After header when one tenant sends more webhooks than the configured limit in the configured window. Put the limiter in src/lib/limiter.ts, wire it into src/routes/webhooks.ts (and src/app.ts if it needs shared state), and read the limit and the window through loadConfig() in src/config.ts with defaults. Add tests in test/webhooks.test.ts or a new test file.
acceptance: A tenant over the limit gets 429 with a Retry-After header
The limit and the window come from config, not constants in a route
The suite stays green with new tests for the 429 path

payload.text:
decision: RateLimiter is shared per-process state on Deps, keyed by tenant with a fixed-window counter.
decision: The rate-limit check runs after tenant validation but before body parsing, reading rateLimitMax and rateLimitWindowMs from loadConfig() with defaults 100 and 60000ms.
decision: A 429 returns JSON error with Retry-After in seconds until window reset, and rejected requests are not stored or audited.
decision: tests: test/config.test.ts changed because exact-match expectations needed the new rateLimitMax and rateLimitWindowMs fields.

What I did:
- Previous run had already added src/lib/limiter.ts (fixed-window RateLimiter) and rateLimitMax/rateLimitWindowMs to src/config.ts via loadConfig().
- This run wired RateLimiter into src/app.ts Deps/createDeps as shared state.
- Wired the check into src/routes/webhooks.ts: over-limit tenants get 429 with Retry-After header.
- Added test/webhooks-rate-limit.test.ts covering 429 + Retry-After, per-tenant isolation, config-driven limit, no store/audit on reject, and unit tests for window reset and tenant isolation.
- Updated test/config.test.ts exact-match expectations for the two new config fields.
- Ran `bun run test` (33 tests, 7 files passed) and `bun run typecheck` (clean) in this worktree.

What I did not finish:
- Nothing outstanding against the acceptance criteria; window-reset over real time is only covered by limiter unit test with injected timestamps, not an end-to-end sleep test.

What I did not look at:
- src/routes/admin.ts, events.ts, audit.ts, src/lib/store.ts/tenants.ts/audit.ts/backoff.ts internals, src/server.ts, and the review-voice-policy skill (not relevant to this task).
